item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the registrant name, starting with a targeted text search around the 10-K cover page fields.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2020_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,el in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:80]):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if 'registrant' in t.lower() or 'exact name' in t.lower():
        print(i, el.get('page_no'), repr(t[:300]))
PY"
